meta.name: sprint-plan
meta.description: Plan a sprint with capacity estimation, story selection, dependency mapping, and risk identification. Use when preparing for sprint planning, estimating team capacity, selecting stories, or balancing sprint scope against velocity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划冲刺并分配团队容量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在冲刺前进行容量估算和任务选择。
copy.tagline_en: Plan sprints with capacity estimation and story selection
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to estimate team capacity and select stories for a sprint.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的团队信息（如成员、历史速度、待办事项）来规划一个冲刺。它会估算团队容量、选择并排序用户故事、识别依赖和风险，最后生成一份冲刺计划摘要。
howto.when: 当你准备进行冲刺规划会议，需要估算团队容量、选择故事或平衡冲刺范围与速度时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划下周的冲刺，团队有5人，每人可用6天。
say.note: Claude 会估算容量并选择故事。

say.text: 根据这份待办列表和上周速度，制定冲刺计划。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并生成计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will plan a sprint based on your team info (members, historical velocity, backlog). It estimates capacity, selects and sequences stories, maps dependencies, identifies risks, and produces a sprint plan summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are preparing for sprint planning, estimating team capacity, selecting stories, or balancing sprint scope against velocity.

say_en.text: Plan next sprint for a team of 5, each available 6 days.
say_en.note: Claude will estimate capacity and select stories.

say_en.text: Use this backlog and last week's velocity to create a sprint plan.
say_en.note: Claude will read files and generate a plan.
